tools.name: get_profile_summary
tools.description: Profile summary: entity (name, canonical @id, sameAs), availability, and machine-readable pointers.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List portfolio projects. Optional filters combine with AND and match case-insensitively; unknown values yield an empty list. Tags are Title Case display strings like "AI Workflow", "Next.js"; matching is case-insensitive so "web3" matches "Web3".

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Full indexed detail for one project by slug, including canonical URL, links, and proof count.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search over the consolidated FAQ (question + answer).

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Verification proof: claim gates, or per-project proof links when a slug is given. Unknown slugs return an error.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Current availability, work scope, and the contact boundary (no raw email is published).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_project, get_availability · Private data: get_availability · Public sink: get_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_project, get_availability · Private data: get_availability · Public sink: get_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
